findings.claim: The size exception remains incomplete under the ADR it activates. can_cu explicitly contains an estimate and says there is no numstat, yet the spec makes owner approval of this unchanged block plus its installing Mission revision sufficient to use a 12-file/+4200 limit and grant the lease. ADR-0053 requires measured git diff --numstat in can_cu. Measuring only before a later code review does not supply the missing evidence in the frozen exception that authorizes execution. Round 2's closure of SPEC-06 overlooked this requirement; the activation OID and four field names are correct, but they do not close the class.

evidence.observed_result: ADR-0053 requires can_cu to include why the packet cannot be split AND a git diff --numstat measurement. SPEC can_cu says 'ước lượng theo thành phần, CHƯA có numstat vì chưa có mã'; ai_nang says the exception takes effect with hash approval/install. The lease prerequisites do not require a revised block with measured numstat.

B3_estimate_admits_no_numstat=true; ADR_requires_measured_numstat_in_can_cu=true. Per-component estimate totals +3967; proposed allowance is 12 files/+4200, versus the activated 6 files/+450. The 11 mandatory changed paths already exceed the file limit. No implementation numstat is present.

findings.suggested_fix: Before treating the exception as effective, attach measured numstat from an authorized representative scratch implementation and issue the spec revision that carries that evidence, then copy the approved block into Mission/lease. Alternatively obtain an explicit durable owner exception to the measurement requirement itself. Keep the current numbers labelled estimates and make lease admission wait for that resolution; do not silently treat later code-review measurement as evidence already in the approved frozen block.
